description: Premise: Join a crew of six unique builder characters on a remote island to construct anything you can imagine using blocks. Gameplay: The game focuses on fun, open-ended play using simple touch gestures and unique controls. There are no specific objectives or competitive play. The Builders: Each of the six characters has a special skill: Blox: Drops and smashes blocks. Vex: Piles blocks into stacks. Stretch: Places blocks in hard-to-reach areas. Cooper: A fantastic painter. Jum-Jum: Uses spray cans to paint. Connie: Lifts and moves blocks efficiently. Features: Creations are saved automatical
